heroText: V-drive and direct-drive specialists. Full shop repairs, gelcoat, upgrades, plus used boats, trucks, and trailers — all from the shop on Meyers Street.
aboutBody:
Xtreme Wake Marine LLC is a veteran-owned shop in Chico specializing in V-drive and direct-drive boats. Full-service repairs, used boat sales, vehicles, new and used trailers, consignment, and purchase.

The photos on this site are from the floor and the lot — the boats in the bay, the trucks on the pavement, and the shop at 247 Meyers Street.
servicesIntro: Full-service shop. Routine maintenance to major repairs and custom work — on the same floor you see in the photos.

services.title: Boat repairs
services.body: Diagnostics and repair for V-drive and direct-drive boats. Shop software covers Malibu, Axis, Nautique, MasterCraft, Tigé and more.

services.title: Pre-purchase inspections
services.body: Thorough mechanical and systems inspections so you know exactly what you are buying.

services.title: Gelcoat repair
services.body: From small chips to larger jobs — on or off trailer. Restore the look and protect the hull.

services.title: Custom upgrades
services.body: Bigger wave, better sound, more power. Custom installs tailored to how you ride.

services.title: Oil, filters & batteries
services.body: Keep the boat reliable. Oil changes, inspections, and battery testing so you never get stranded.

services.title: Consignment & trades
services.body: Sell with less hassle. Marketing, showings, negotiations — plus buying boats and taking trades.
